summary: The bad() entry point reaches a Java assertion whose condition ("".length() > 0) is derived from a trivially-evaluable expression, so when assertions are enabled it always throws an AssertionError (CWE-617 Reachable Assertion). I replaced the assertion with an ordinary runtime length check that logs the outcome, preserving the length-validation behavior without using an assertion as a control-flow/validation mechanism.
